title: fix: use OpenAI-compatible instructions for Qwen TTS
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Renames the Qwen TTS request field from `instruct` to OpenAI-compatible `instructions`.
- Sends the same plural field to DashScope as `parameters.instructions`.
- Updates JSON, multipart, simple-audio, and OpenAPI schemas.
- Updates the existing Qwen integration test to verify the exact upstream payload.

Tests:
- `npx vitest run test/index.test.ts -t Qwen --reporter=verbose`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npx biome check gen.pollinations.ai/src/routes/audio.ts gen.pollinations.ai/src/routes/generation-handlers.ts gen.pollinations.ai/test/index.test.ts`

gist.headline: Instructions, plural, delivered
gist.blurb: Qwen TTS now understands the OpenAI-compatible spelling of its directions. One small plural made it all the way to DashScope, as plurals occasionally must.
gist.summary: Renamed Qwen TTS's `instruct` request field to OpenAI-compatible `instructions` across JSON, multipart, simple-audio, and OpenAPI schemas, forwarding it upstream as `parameters.instructions` to DashScope.
gist.impact: Developers can send Qwen TTS voice directions using the documented `instructions` field, and those directions now reach DashScope in the exact expected payload shape.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy audio-routing scene: Polli carefully carries a labeled plural `instructions` note from an OpenAI-style microphone terminal to a Qwen TTS speaker garden, where DashScope receives it and the sound-wave flowers bloom. The key visual joke is a tiny missing-s turned into a clearly delivered, useful note.
